subject: Sharon Hays School Committee Interview
overview: School Committee member Sharon Hays discussed her legislative priorities, including student mental health and district-wide equity initiatives. The conversation addressed the impact of the pandemic on student development and the challenges of local governance.

items.title: Pride event fundraiser
items.summary: Announced a t-shirt fundraiser for Medford's first Pride event with proceeds benefiting the Medford High School GSA.

items.title: Introduction of Sharon Hays
items.summary: Sharon Hays introduced herself as a former teacher and newly elected School Committee member who took office in January 2022.

items.title: Candidacy and DEI motivations
items.summary: Hays explained that her decision to run was motivated by concerns regarding diversity, equity, and inclusion during the Missituk School renaming process.

items.title: District equity and middle school lottery
items.summary: Supported the use of the middle school lottery system and external equity consultants to improve socioeconomic and racial balance across the district.

items.title: Governance and Open Meeting Law
items.summary: Discussed the challenges of building consensus among committee members given the legal restrictions on informal communication outside public meetings.

items.title: Legislative priorities and assessments
items.summary: Identified student mental health funding, staff diversification, and the implementation of more timely academic assessments as primary goals.

items.title: Post-pandemic student development
items.summary: Analyzed the social-emotional and developmental lags observed in elementary students following the transition from remote to in-person learning.

items.title: Constituent outreach
items.summary: Requested community feedback on accessible locations for office hours and encouraged residents to contact committee members collectively regarding shared concerns.

items.title: Personal background and advocacy
items.summary: Shared a personal history of early interest in social activism and attendance at anti-nuclear rallies.
